title: Yellow Pages Egypt scraper summary
description: The summary dict returned by run(). Per-business data is emitted via ctx.dataset.push() (see dataset_schema.json).

input_ref.description: The category slug (category mode) or profile URL (profile mode) that was crawled.

records_pushed.description: Total dataset records emitted (parent profiles + flat branch records).

profiles.description: Number of top-level (parent / listing) profiles captured.

branches.description: Number of branch sub-profiles captured and nested.

pages_crawled.description: Listing pages walked (category mode; 0 in profile mode).

failed.description: Profiles that could not be captured (dead/redirected/stale).
